我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一具庞大的残骸，看上去似乎是一台粒子加速器。它位于一个充满辐射的巨大弹坑中，这意味着这台加速器是[Root.GetPlanetMoon]核战中非常重要的战略目标之一。

我们找到了一些负责这台加速器的科学家所写的日志，尽管这项科技的开发很不完善，但是其中不少研究和公式哪怕对我们的科技标准来说都算是闻所未闻的先进知识，我们的物理学家已经在研究这些数据了。
texts.en:
We have discovered what appears to be the remains of a massive particle accelerator on [Root.GetName]. It was found in a still-radioactive region covered in massive bomb craters, suggesting the accelerator was considered a strategic target of great importance during the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s nuclear war.

We have recovered several research logs written by the scientist in charge of the accelerator. Although the technology of her civilization was fairly underdeveloped, some of the theoretical research and formulas described in the logs are advanced even by our standards. Our physicists are poring over the data now.

# 破损的粒子加速器 / Ruined Particle Accelerator

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/colony_events_1.txt:3624-3682

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2或3岁时的随机事件（75/958、50/739）：核爆废土殖民地（pc_nuked）、非首都、非AI；每个帝国一次（had_colony_160）。
  Random colony event at age 2 or 3 (75/958, 50/739): a nuked wasteland (pc_nuked) non-capital colony of a non-AI empire; once per empire (had_colony_160).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「废弃的粒子加速器」：核爆废土殖民地获得遗留的粒子加速器矿藏。
  Ruined Particle Accelerator: a nuked wasteland colony gains an ancient particle accelerator deposit.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
